title: GTA 6 In-Game Radio Stations Announced, and You Can Preview Them Right Now
text: GTA 6 In-Game Radio Stations Announced, and You Can Preview Them Right Now | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA 6 GTA 6 In-Game Radio Stations Announced, and You Can Preview Them Right Now Tune in by Stephen Tailby 7 hours ago Share: Rockstar Games has given us another GTA 6 crumb to enjoy; it's announced some of the in-game radio stations we'll be able to enjoy as we drive around Leonida, and you can get a taste for them right now. It's all unveiled on the official website in a new blog post . It's stated that GTA 6 will have the "biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet," and six of the stations you can listen to have been unveiled. They're as follows: Cocoteo FM : Leonida's home for the best of modern Latin music. Hosted by El Martillo and La Gata and featuring everything from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton — Cocoteo FM is el party que nunca se apaga . Back Country Radio : MW and Delta Dawne blast renegade country music to the Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, and beyond. Stay tuned for Back Country’s roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and Delta’s not-so-secret lover Mud Dog Mike checking in from the driver’s seat of his Grassrivers airboat. AfroBank FM: Turn up the gbedu with Burna and Palmsy, AfroBank FM's dynamic duo curating the best in African music, from 20th-century classics and undiscovered gems to contemporary sounds like amapiano, 3-step, and more. The Chamber 106.6: Crushing metal has landed in Leonida. Jump in the pit with DJ Kerry and DJ Tom for classic metal from the ‘80s and beyond as they channel Leonida’s deep metal roots. Flash FM: The Vice City institution that delivers the best in pop music with Robyn and Alex — guaranteed to make you dance no matter where you find yourself in the Goodtime State. Dirty South Classics : A little southern hospitality from Trick and Trina, blasting regional rap and hip-hop classics. From the beach to the block, nobody reps Leonida and the South like they do. If you follow this link , you'll be able to listen to previews of each of these stations to give you a feel for the vibe they bring to the game. Through these previews, a number of licensed tracks have been revealed: Bad Bunny - EoO Axel Rulay ft. Farruko & El Alfa - Si Es Trucho Es Trucho (Remix) Romeo Santos & El Chaval de la Bachata - Canalla David Allan Coe - Need a Little Time Off for Bad Behavior Loretta Lynn - Don't Come Home A-Drinkin' (With Lovin' On Your Mind) Hank Williams, Jr. & Waylon Jennings - The Conversation Asake - Joha Pat Thomas ft. Ebo Taylor - Gye Wani DJ Lag & Robot Boii ft. Kamo Mphela - Shay'sana Black Sabbath - I Pantera - I'm Broken Slayer - Raining Blood Charli xcx - Good Ones MGMT - Electric Feel Zara Larsson & PinkPantheress - Midnight Sun (Girls Trip) David Banner ft. Lil' Flip - Like A Pimp JT Money ft. Solé - Who Dat DJ Khaled ft. Trick Daddy, Rick Ross & Pitbull - Born N Raised On top of the in-game radio, GTA 6 will also feature "a series of on-demand podcasts" for the first time. You'll be able to listen to radio and podcasts while driving and on-foot "through newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their smartphones."
